headlines.text: Rewind to 2025, when Jon Moxley vs. Powerhouse Hobbs went to battle over the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.69. It marked Jon Moxley's 20th match with the title on the line. Moxley retained the AEW World Title over Hobbs, biting his ear bloody before the Death Riders and interference from Marina Shafir helped him lock in the Bulldog Choke for the submission win.
On this day in 2020, Diamond Dallas Page kicked off their AEW journey, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.22.

On a Wednesday in 2025, back when AEW welcomed Megan Bayne for the first time in a Casino Gauntlet match against Toni Storm vs. Harley Cameron vs. Jamie Hayter vs. Julia Hart vs. Kris Statlander vs. Willow Nightingale, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.64.
